camera.title: Bedroom - frontal view of the bed wall
camera.notes: Frontal view of the bed wall: vertical smoked-walnut slats across the whole wall, centred behind the bed a tall backlit honey-onyx panel glowing warm gold with an ivory channel headboard in front of it, two alabaster pendants. The room is dark and moody - deep taupe walls, dark walnut floor - with bright ivory and gold details.
